title: Worktrees for sprint workers have the commit hooks
goal: A sprint worker's git worktree runs the repository's commit hooks, so its commits carry their KB-* trailers when made, not only after sync rewrites them; from the SP-4fbfzobr retrospective, where every worker commit lacked them.

gates.question: A clone whose shared core.hooksPath is an absolute path to the main clone's .githooks (git runs those scripts in every worktree, and they start the worktree's own kbgit.py): how do install-hooks and sync judge it in a worktree?
options: count it as installed when the path is the .githooks of a worktree of the clone holding the hook scripts, and leave the value alone
have install-hooks rewrite it to the relative .githooks, so each worktree runs its own scripts
keep counting only this checkout's .githooks, and add a worktree hint to sync's note
gates.recommendation: count it as installed when the path is the .githooks of a worktree of the clone holding the hook scripts, and leave the value alone
gates.answer: count it as installed when the path is the .githooks of a worktree of the clone holding the hook scripts, and leave the value alone
